_instructions: Spec template for `kappmaker generate-image --spec <file>` — generic structured prompt for any one-off image (illustration, empty-state art, onboarding graphic, background, hero shot...).
Fill every field that applies and DELETE the ones that don't; keys starting with `_` are stripped before the spec is sent to the image model.
This is a proven BASELINE, not a rigid schema: any JSON object works — add fields, restructure, or write a richer spec whenever that better captures the request. No mechanical constraints here.
Structured JSON steers the model noticeably better than prose: be concrete in subject and composition, keep color_palette to 2-4 values, and state hard rules in constraints.
Aspect ratio / resolution are CLI flags (--aspect-ratio, --resolution), not spec fields — but mention the intended framing in composition so the design fits it.
When passing --reference images, describe in `references_usage` how each reference should be used.
text_in_image: none — no text, labels, or lettering unless explicitly listed here
